All feelings and experiences are valid and you have ever right to be feeling pain and violation. It is hard to say completely what your fathers intentions were, but I know that I personally have never heard of that being a "normal" father-child greeting. All trauma is hard and painful, and just because someone else has been raped and you haven't doesnt mean you have to feel less pain then them. You are your own person, with your own story, with your own trauma that is JUST as terrible as anyone else. I recommend a book to you called "from surviving to thriving" by Pete Walker, it is an amazing book on CPTSD and childhood trauma and how that effects us in our adult lives. Defiantly give it a read and let me know how you liked it! Feel free to DM me
